items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: But I never could get to see him. And I left before I saw him

ctx.x: He lived out there. Oh, yeah.
He still out. I stayed at his house, Professor Minetta and I, about a month. Yeah, we stayed there.
Well, I lived there's about six squares from him. Oh, really? But I never could get to see him. And I left before I saw him, but I really wanted to see him because-
